method: Scraped from https://www.etsy.com/your/shops/me/advertising/listings/<id> via authenticated browser. Etsy exposes no API for ads stats.
window_warning: TWO WINDOWS ON ONE PAGE. The headline metrics (views/clicks/orders/revenue/spend/roas) are scoped 'This year (Jan - Sep 2026)'. The targeted-keyword table is scoped 'over the last 30 days'. They are NOT the same period and must never be divided into one another.
raw_note: keyword_rows are captured VERBATIM from each table row's textContent, whitespace-collapsed, with only Etsy's repeated tooltip string ('Turn off keywords that aren't relevant...') and the trailing 'Relevant keyword' toggle label removed. Values stay label-prefixed exactly as Etsy renders them ('ROAS0Orders0Spend$0...'). Nothing is normalised, spell-corrected or merged.
distinct_from_listing_stats: Ads counts VIEWS (impressions the ad was shown for). Listing stats counts VISITS (people who arrived). They are different metrics and the keyword lists answer different questions: a targeted keyword is what Etsy matched the ad to, whether or not anyone came; a search term is what a buyer typed and arrived on. 'geometric embroidery pattern' is targeted on 4466080258 and appears nowhere in that listing's search terms.
known_conflict: Listing 4466080258 reports 2 orders / $12 here and 1 sold / $6.00 in the same-day listing-stats pull. Recorded, not reconciled — the definitions and windows differ and neither number is edited to agree with the other.

listings.note: Ad is running (246 views, 3 clicks, $0.20 spend) but Etsy renders no targeted-keyword table for it.

unreadable.note: Every headline metric returned null across a 4s wait — page did not render in time, or the listing has no ad. Recorded as unverified rather than as zero.
